title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches New and Edit as built from the object's fields and field groups, and showOnCreate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91tYCagMT6JaQ6YA5YqnWwi)_
Fixes #36455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照着界面技能写应用的 AI,今后把「新建 / 编辑」表单的分区、折叠和「新建时不问这个字段」写在对象的字段和字段分组上,不再去写一张已经没人加载的内部表单。
- 为什么做:这是「内部新建和编辑表单退役」那件事的收尾。平台已经改了,技能包还在教旧写法。
- 出错会怎样:AI 照旧文字写出的表单布局不生效,也不知道有「新建时显示」这个开关。本次只改技能文字和它的评测题,撤回这一个合并就恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:技能包属于受管文件,需要你审阅并合并;本单保持草稿。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui` taught the object's internal create and edit form views (`form`, `formViews.create`, `modalSize`, the form-view `subforms` override). After #36425 (PR #36449, then PR #36543) the Console's create and edit surfaces load none of them. The skill now teaches what `main` does.

- **`SKILL.md`**, Traps 1: New and Edit are the object's fields and `fieldGroups`, never a form view; `showOnCreate: false` keeps a field off every create surface and is refused beside `required: true`. The "Where to go" row for forms names the object as the place the New / Edit form is authored, and keeps the named and public forms under `src/views/*.view.ts`.
- **`rules/list-views.md`**, "Form Views": rewritten. New and Edit are built from the object (fields, sectioned by `fieldGroups` in array order, following the fields' own rules); `collapse: 'collapsed'` on a group folds a rarely filled section; `showOnCreate: false` and its refusal; dialog size and column count are derived. A container's `form`, `formViews.default` and `formViews.create` still parse and steer nothing, and `os validate` warns `form-view-internal-not-loaded`. Kept, as the two kinds of form view that load: a named `formViews` entry (`OBJECT.key`) that an action of type `form` opens at `/forms/:name`, and a public form, whose paragraph is unchanged.
- **`rules/list-views.md`**, the `defineView` container example: the default `form` is replaced by a named `formViews` entry (still an `os:check` block).
- **`rules/list-views.md`**, "Master-Detail Forms": option 2 (form-view `subforms`) is removed, because no create or edit surface reads it any more. The parent field group naming the child (option 1) and the page block stay. `taxRateField` is attributed to the page block, the only schema that declares it.
- **`evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`**: evals 1, 6, 13 and 19 taught or assumed an internal form view. Each now expects the object's field groups and `showOnCreate`. `evals/README.md` names the new coverage.
- **`.changeset/36455-ui-skill-create-surfaces.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch. The changeset check requires it: a `skills/**` change releases that package and never takes the skip label.

Both ratcheted files end at the token count they started at: the new text is paid for by cuts in the same file. The bundle total rises by 141 tokens, all of it in the two eval files, which the ratchet measures and does not price (`skills/README.md` says `evals/` is inert in a consumer install). Readings taken at `f7c9b8465b` against base `f4c2d0b1b9`.

### Where each sentence comes from

Every behavioural claim in the new text, with the code on `main` (`f4c2d0b1b9`) that makes it true.

| Claim | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `showOnCreate` is an optional boolean on a field; absent or `true` means asked for on create | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2931` |
| `showOnCreate: false` beside `required: true` is refused, with or without a `defaultValue`; `requiredWhen` is the way out | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:3253-3271` |
| Every create surface leaves such a field out; edit keeps it | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:206-211` (`isFieldAskedOnFlow`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormFields.ts:29-40` |
| The three hosts use that one list: the dialog, the full-page form, an action-opened form | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1791`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx:296`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx:289` |
| No internal form view is read: sections, tabs, subforms, `modalSize`, buttons, layout, `defaults` | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:1752-1757`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:213-240` |
| Sections come from `fieldGroups` in declared order | `packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts:16-17` |
| `collapse: 'collapsed'` on a group folds its section in the form | `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1602-1603`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts:121-122` |
| The dialog sizes itself when no size is passed, and the hosts pass none (only the phone posture's `full`) | `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx:565-590`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:213-240` |
| `form`, `formViews.default`, `formViews.create` are reported as `form-view-internal-not-loaded`, a warning, by the check tools; a public form and a form under any other name are not | `packages/lint/src/validate-internal-form-views.ts:16-31` and `:76-128`, `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1832-1844` |
| A `formViews` entry is registered as `OBJECT.key` | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:8092-8101` |
| An action of type `form` opens `/forms/:name` with `target` as the name | `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:2931-2950`, `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:456` |
| A named form's `type` is `simple`, `tabbed` or `wizard`, and the page draws each | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5341-5343`, `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:290` and `:2834-2847` |
| A wizard step lists `fields`; `group` on one is refused | `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:5710-5731` |
| A named form draws no child line items | `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`: zero matches for `subforms`, `relatedList` and `MasterDetail`; control: the same file matches `wizard` 33 times |
| Child line items on create and edit come only from `fieldGroups[].relatedList` | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts:185-198` |
| `taxRateField` is a key of the master-detail page block | `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:7552` (no other declaration under `packages/spec/src`) |

## Tests

No package source changes, so no package test suite is owed. What was run:

- `check:skill-examples` (not in the derived list; run because an `os:check` block changed), after building the `@objectstack/client-react` dependency closure under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 43 of 43 tasks): `349 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- The edited eval file through the repo's own loader (`parseEvalFile`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`): 23 cases, 0 refusals.
- No ablation: the diff changes documentation and eval fixtures, and no behaviour a test pins.

## Acceptance notes

- **The three dispatch assumptions.** (1) Confirmed: Traps 1 and "Form Views" were the stale passages, and the container example's `form` was dead for create and edit. Also stale, and corrected: Master-Detail option 2, the "Where to go" row, and four eval cases. (2) Partly falsified: of `columns`, `collapse` and `modalSize`, only `collapse` on a field group is still honoured on create and edit. A field group has no `columns` key, and the hosts pass no `modalSize`. (3) Confirmed: the parent field group naming the child is live and is kept.
- **A stepped create form with line items** (eval 6) can no longer be authored as one form view: New and Edit load no wizard, and a named form draws no child lines. The eval now expects the field-group order and says so.
- **Not changed, on purpose.** `rules/navigation.md` "Record Presentation" already says width and columns are derived; its `sections` ladder still applies to named forms and page blocks. The `form` row of the Action Types table still holds. `references/react-blocks.md` is generated; its `modalSize` sentence follows the spec `describe` text, which #36544 carries.
- **Noted, not changed here (outside this card's files).** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:278` still points at "`subforms` overrides" in this skill's Master-Detail section, which no longer has one. No file under `skills/objectstack-data` teaches `showOnCreate`, though the key is a field key. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:44` and `skills/README.md:125` send a stepped form to a wizard form view without saying it must be a named form an action opens.
- **Noted, not filed.** A named or public form carries a section's `collapsed` through (`FormPage.tsx:933-934`) and no render code in that file reads it. Read from source only; not reproduced in a browser. The new text does not teach `collapsed` on a form-view section.

## Verification

Head `f7c9b8465b`.

**Read first** (by risk): 1. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, the "Form Views" hunk: every sentence is new teaching. 2. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, eval 6: the expected answer changed from a wizard to field-group order. 3. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, Traps 1.

**Two-minute check:** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md is 2230 tokens (ceiling 2272` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md is 4447 tokens (ceiling 4448`, and exits 0.
